passages.question: Which lookback period applies for 2026, and what must a semiweekly depositor file with Form 941?
passages.excerpt: For 2026, the lookback period begins July 1, 2024, and ends June 30, 2025. ... If you reported more than $50,000 of taxes for the lookback period, you're a semiweekly schedule depositor. Check the third box on line 16. You must complete Schedule B (Form 941) and submit it with your Form 941.
